FROM amazoncorretto:25
ENV APP_NAME=urbo-cms

EXPOSE 8080

ADD https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases/download/v2.11.0/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar /opentelemetry-javaagent.jar

COPY urbo-app/build/libs/urbo-app.jar /app.jar

ENV SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod
ENV SERVICE_NAME=urbco-cms-backend
ENV NAMESPACE=urbo

ENV JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-javaagent:/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar -Dotel.resource.attributes=service.name=$SERVICE_NAME -Dotel.resource.attributes.deployment.environment=$SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE -Dotel.resource.attributes.service.namespace=$NAMESPACE"

ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app.jar"]
